symptom: Outcome Ledger validator reads inherited required fields and permits non-enumerable/accessor/symbol record properties or sparse evidence-digest arrays. Canonical hashing enumerates a different JSON property set, so invalid or divergent payloads can enter digest/append admission despite the direct-digest validation guard.
lesson: Validating field values without validating their own enumerable data-property shape and array density is insufficient for canonical digest and JSON persistence equivalence.
guardrail: Reuse Forward Vault own-data/prototype guardrails: reject exotic record prototypes/toJSON hooks, inherited or non-enumerable required fields, accessors, symbol properties and sparse/modified evidence arrays before digest or append classification; preserve valid-record digest bytes and research-only isolation.
